title: Add second subcontractor (Local Assembly) to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data now includes a second subcontractor (Local Assembly) alongside the renamed Bulk Assembly subcontractor, with corresponding work centers, locations, and routing updates to support dual-sourcing scenarios.
key_points: Existing subcontractor renamed to Bulk Assembly (vendor 82000, work center 500, location code changed from 82000 to S82000)
New second subcontractor Local Assembly added (vendor 83000, work center 600 with capacity 40, location S83000)
Inventory posting setup rows added for S82000 and S83000, created after the locations exist
Routing SP-SCM1009-SUB-2 now uses work center 600 (concurrent capacity 100 to 40); SUB-1 stays on work center 500
Forward-only demo data: databases already seeded with the old records are not migrated or overwritten
quote: Modern SCM demos need dual-sourcing across multiple subcontractors.
